shortDescription: Allows the editing of IP Pool Objects within FortiManager.

options.name: adom
options.description: The ADOM the configuration should belong to.

options.name: arp_intf
options.description: Select an interface from available options that will reply to ARP requests. (If blank, any is selected).

options.name: arp_reply
options.description: Enable/disable replying to ARP requests when an IP Pool is added to a policy (default = enable). choice | disable | Disable ARP reply. choice | enable | Enable ARP reply.

options.name: associated_interface
options.description: Associated interface name.

options.name: block_size
options.description: Number of addresses in a block (64 to 4096, default = 128).

options.name: comments
options.description: Comment.

options.name: dynamic_mapping
options.description: EXPERTS ONLY! KNOWLEDGE OF FMGR JSON API IS REQUIRED! List of multiple child objects to be added. Expects a list of dictionaries. Dictionaries must use FortiManager API parameters, not the ansible ones listed below. If submitted, all other prefixed sub-parameter.ARE IGNORED. This object is MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with its options. We expect that you know what you are doing with these list parameters, and are leveraging the JSON API Guide. WHEN IN DOUBT, USE THE SUB OPTIONS BELOW INSTEAD TO CREATE OBJ

options.name: dynamic_mapping_arp_intf
options.description: Dynamic Mapping clone of original suffixed parameter.

options.description: Dynamic Mapping clone of original suffixed parameter.

options.name: endip
options.description: Final IPv4 address (inclusive) in the range for the address pool (format xxx.xxx.xxx.xxx, Default| 0.0.0.0).

options.name: mode
options.description: Sets one of three modes for managing the object. Allows use of soft-adds instead of overwriting existing values

options.name: name
options.description: IP pool name.

options.name: num_blocks_per_user
options.description: Number of addresses blocks that can be used by a user (1 to 128, default = 8).

options.name: pba_timeout
options.description: Port block allocation timeout (seconds).

options.name: permit_any_host
options.description: Enable/disable full cone NAT. choice | disable | Disable full cone NAT. choice | enable | Enable full cone NAT.

options.name: source_endip
options.description: Final IPv4 address (inclusive) in the range of the source addresses to be translated (format xxx.xxx.xxx.xxx, Default| 0.0.0.0).

options.name: source_startip
options.description: First IPv4 address (inclusive) in the range of the source addresses to be translated (format xxx.xxx.xxx.xxx, Default| 0.0.0.0).

options.name: startip
options.description: First IPv4 address (inclusive) in the range for the address pool (format xxx.xxx.xxx.xxx, Default| 0.0.0.0).

options.name: type
options.description: IP pool type (overload, one-to-one, fixed port range, or port block allocation). choice | overload | IP addresses in the IP pool can be shared by clients. choice | one-to-one | One to one mapping. choice | fixed-port-range | Fixed port range. choice | port-block-allocation | Port block allocation.
